data.cultural_impact: In Hindu tradition, the name Sarathi holds a deep cultural significance as it is often associated with the deity Saraswati, who is known as the goddess of knowledge, wisdom and learning. Sarathi also has a connection to Lord Krishna, who is referred to as Sarathi or the charioteer of Arjuna, guiding him throughout the Battle of Mahabharata.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sarathi holds great spiritual significance in Hinduism. The word Sarathi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘saratha’ which means ‘charioteer’ or ‘driver’. In Hinduism, the deity Vishnu is often depicted as Sarathi, or the one who guides and transports the individual souls on the journey towards enlightenment and liberation from the cycle of reincarnation.
